*Functions of Management and Strategic Management*
*Mr. Philips – Planning (Strategy Formulation):*
Forecasting market trends and setting future objectives represents the planning function. It is the foundation of strategy formulation because an organization must first analyze external conditions and establish long-term goals before deciding on a specific course of action.

*Mr. Omer – Organizing (Strategy Implementation):*
Departmentalization and delegating authority fall under organizing. This aligns with strategy implementation, as turning strategic plans into action requires structuring tasks, assigning responsibilities, and coordinating resources effectively.

*Mr. Murtaza – Motivation (Strategy Implementation):*

Addressing low morale and communication barriers reflects motivation. During strategy implementation, strategies only succeed when leaders inspire, guide, and engage employees to work toward the new organizational goals.

*Mr. Haris – Staffing (Strategy Implementation):*

Recruiting and training skilled personnel for global operations is staffing. In strategy implementation, having qualified human resources with the right competencies is essential to execute strategic plans smoothly.

*Mr. Clark – Controlling (Strategy Evaluation):*

Monitoring actual performance against set targets represents controlling.
